187d48cd9701.en: On a phone, "Log my hours" opens one simple screen: the project, today or yesterday, your items as large buttons and a running total. Supervisors log their gang. Approvers see each person's week, with long days and weekend work flagged, and approved hours are locked. Every hour is costed at your rates in the project report.

2c6b920b6efe.en: Supervisors log the gang's hours in one go and adjust anyone who differs.

72fbf71cc4bb.en: Does the timesheet app work offline?

4ac1fd438be0.en: No. I-Cost needs a mobile or Wi-Fi connection to save hours, so they reach the office straight away.

af441ea620e4.en: Do I need to download an app?

7dd7e0aaabb3.en: No app store needed. Open I-Cost in the phone's browser and add it to the home screen; it then opens like an app, with a "Log my hours" shortcut.

206bd1a284ee.en: Company admins approve everything; project managers, project leads, site managers and supervisors approve on the projects they are on. Nobody can approve their own hours.

b0cd2ebc939f.en: Can a supervisor log hours for the whole gang?

d42b8cbb5a4a.en: Yes. The people from the supervisor's last timesheet are ticked already, one tap sets everyone's hours, and each person's hours can still be changed.
